topic: Paying a storefront preparer vs using free filing for a simple return (Gordon vs Lucille)

scenes.narration: Millions pay to file returns they could file for free. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a tax form stamped FREE beside a receipt stamped TWO EIGHTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gordon and Lucille both have simple returns with one job.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man gordon and woman lucille holding single wage statements, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each takes the standard deduction with no business income.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two tax forms with STANDARD DEDUCTION checked, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gordon walks into a storefront preparer in February.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man gordon entering a bright tax preparation storefront, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Preparation and state filing cost him two hundred eighty.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an itemized receipt reading PREP AND STATE TWO EIGHTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The software upsold products he never needed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a screen offering add on products with checkboxes already ticked, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lucille checks the official free filing program first.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman lucille at a laptop showing an official free filing seal, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her income qualifies, so both returns cost nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a screen reading FEDERAL AND STATE FILED FREE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Free help from trained volunteers is available locally.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a community center table with a sign reading FREE TAX HELP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She files in forty minutes and picks direct deposit.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman lucille finishing a return with a clock reading FORTY MINUTES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same refund, two hundred eighty dollars apart.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two identical refund checks beside a scoreboard reading TWO EIGHTY APART, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Check free filing before paying anyone. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym holding a clipboard reading FILE FREE FIRST, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
